hotel_name: Santo Mauro, a Luxury Collection Hotel

claims.text: The palace was built by architect Juan Bautista Lázaro between 1889 and 1902 as a residence for the Duke of Santo Mauro.

findings.quote: The Palace of Santo Mauro was built by architect Juan Bautista Lázaro between 1889 and 1902 as a residence for the Duke of Santo Mauro.

claims.text: The hotel consists of three buildings set in a private garden with fountains and terraces shaded by ancient chestnut trees.

findings.quote: consists of three buildings set in a sophisticated private garden, with fountains and terraces shaded by ancient chestnut trees

claims.text: The Red Room reflects French Classicism, while oriental pieces in the Chinese Lounge recall objects the Duke collected on his travels.

findings.quote: The Red Room reflects pure French Classicism, while the oriental pieces in the Chinese Lounge recall the objects the Duke used to collect on his travels.

claims.text: The ducal family still owns the palace, acting as its stewards.

findings.quote: The ducal family still retains ownership of the palace, acting as its stewards.

claims.text: The palace is in the Golden Triangle neighborhood, long the center of aristocratic life in Madrid and home to aristocratic residences, embassies and art galleries.

findings.quote: The palace is located in the neighborhood known as the Golden Triangle, which for centuries was the center of aristocratic life in Madrid and has been a popular location for aristocratic residences, embassies, and high-end art galleries.

claims.text: The hotel is in the city center, close to the design area and the city's most renowned museums.

findings.quote: The hotel's location, in the city center close to the design area and to the city's most renowned museums

claims.text: All rooms and suites have marble bathrooms, luxury bedding and high-speed Wi-Fi.

findings.quote: All the rooms and suites are designed with high-quality finishes, marble bathrooms, luxury bedding, and high-speed Wi-Fi

claims.text: The minibar holds Madrid specialties, including a local wine selected by the sommelier, local pastries and traditional Spanish crisps.

findings.quote: The minibar contains some authentic examples of the gastronomy of Madrid: a local wine selected by our sommelier, delicious indigenous pastries and traditional Spanish crisps

claims.text: Gresca Wine Bar has a cellar of more than 250 references, including national, international and natural wines.

findings.quote: its extensive cellar of more than 250 references stands out, betting on national and international wines, as well as natural wines
## Gresca de Santo Mauro

claims.text: The signature Casilda cocktail is served complimentary to in-house guests every day.

findings.quote: Served complimentary daily from 6 to 8 p.m., inviting in-house guests to unwind and savor timeless elegance.
Crafted in honor of Jasmina de Casilda, our signature cocktail is more than a drink

claims.text: The hotel offers a walking tour of Madrid's Chamberí district.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in Madrid’s elegant Chamberí with our exclusive walking tour.

claims.text: The hotel has a fully equipped fitness centre open 24 hours.

findings.quote: A fully equipped fitness centre, open 24 hours, for guests who wish to stay active.

claims.text: The hotel retains its original interior design, including a Modernist staircase in the entrance hall, a small oval courtyard, an old chapel and the Duke's library.

findings.quote: The hotel retains its original interior design, boasting unique details such as the Modernist staircase in the entrance hall, a small oval courtyard, an old chapel, and the Duke's library.

claims.text: The Duke's Royal Suite was the original Duke's bedroom, with walls covered in green velvet.

findings.quote: The Suite Royal The Duke's , was the original Duke's bedroom. The walls are all covered with a marvellous green velvet

claims.text: The garden was shaped under the guidance of landscape artist Fernando Valero, with fountains and historic trees.

findings.quote: Under the guidance of landscape artist Fernando Valero the natural beauty of this space, complemented by its striking fountains and historic trees, invites relaxation, reflection, and reinvigoration.
Possibly the loveliest garden in Madrid. The garden is the jewel in the Palace's crown

claims.text: The Luxury Terrace Suite is a bi-level suite with a garden view and a terrace.

findings.quote: Bi-level Suite, 1 King, Garden view, Terrace

claims.text: The hotel keeps a cabinet of curiosities in the tradition of Madrid's aristocratic collectors.

findings.quote: The Santo Mauro keeps that experience alive with its cabinet of curiosities.
In the past, Madrid’s aristocrats were among the privileged few who could travel the world, cultivating not just their intellect and social connections but also their collections of exotic valuables

claims.text: Pets are allowed but not in the indoor food and beverage outlets.

findings.quote: Pets allowed, not permitted in indoor F&B outlets.

claims.text: Rooms at the hotel do not have a fridge.

findings.quote: No, rooms at Santo Mauro, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Madrid do not have a fridge.
